display_long_description:
🔥PLANT. SHOOT. SURVIVE.

A VR hybrid of tower defense and first-person combat — you fight inside collapsing defenses.

A Plants vs Zombies-inspired VR battle experience where you are inside the fight.


🌱 Strategic Plant Defense

Grow 16 unique plants to defend your base while surviving constant zombie attacks.
[media]

🪴 Your Defense Becomes Your Weapon

When chaos breaks out, rip plants directly from the ground and use them in combat. Your defense system becomes your arsenal.
[media]

🔫 First-Person VR Combat

Move, shoot, and survive inside collapsing defenses as massive zombie waves push forward. Face 9+ zombie types, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns.
[media]

🧟 Boss Battles & Progression

Face massive bosses like the Toilet Zombie across 24 levels of escalating challenge.
[media]

🌿 The invasion never stops growing.

Your garden is under siege.

Survive it.
